title: Document research with independently completing sections
points: The simplified research path reads original filings, PSX announcements and economic documents; dated PSX market snapshots remain available.
Normalized financial statements, precomputed ratios and saved financial model calculations are bypassed. Historical models remain readable.
Broad questions can be answered in up to three sections, with progress showing actual searches and page reading. Follow-ups can reuse source evidence.
Company discovery and documentation are simpler. Source transcription errors and missing periods remain limitations to verify against the linked originals.
